t: Rising in front of you is 25 Bank Street, an office tower in Canary Wharf, in the Docklands area of London. Today it houses the European headquarters of the investment bank JPMorgan Chase. It was designed by César Pelli, the Argentine-American architect, who also shaped several of its neighbours in this district. Look around and you will see his towers sharing the skyline, which gives this part of Canary Wharf a consistent look.
